'''Clak'dor VII''', also known as '''Bith''',<ref name="GotJ">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Ghost of the Jedi]]''</ref> was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the large white [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Colu/Legends|Colu]] in the [[Colu system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. It was a long-time member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
===Ecological disaster===
[[File:BarquinDan-Databank.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A typical [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].]]
The Bith evolved over the millennia, and making use of their powerful senses of sight and hearing became a race of [[Artist/Legends|artists]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Musician/Legends|musicians]]. They built great [[City/Legends|cities]] in the mountains and the jungles of Clak'dor VII. However, around [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], a [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|conflict]] erupted on the planet between the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Weogar/Legends|Weogar]] and its [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] counterpart [[Nozho/Legends|Nozho]] over a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|stardrive]] patent.<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> When subterfuge was detected by Weogar, war soon broke out and a chemical attack was launched by Nozho on the capital. The retaliatory biological strike on Nozho wiped the city out and destroyed Clak'dor VII's ecosystem, destroying the planet's ability to produce either the basic needs for its citizens or goods for export. The populace was decimated, though from the ruins of Nozho came the offshoot [[Y'bith/Legends|Y'bith]] subspecies who would go on to colonize [[Clak'dor IV]]. The surviving Bith on the planet were forced to relocate into domed cities, now proclaiming themselves pacifists and seldom venturing into the irradiated swamps, where the wildlife mutated into such lifeforms as the [[Ghhhk/Legends|Ghhhk]].

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|&hellip;you're on the wrong side of this war. Your entire species.''"<br />"''Clak'dor Seven had little choice. The Separatists were offering unrestricted access to hyperspace routes, better deals on trade goods, no interference&hellip;|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Thal K'sar]] discussing Bith support for the CIS|<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
Clak'dor VII was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] directly by [[Dodra F'ass]] until the planet seceded in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> Though many Bith, like F'ass, retreated to their homeworld and seldom participated in battles, being pacifists, the Bith supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with technological and artistic contributions: to the Bith, the Confederacy was opposing a morally corrupt Republic.

===Joining the New Republic===
The Bith were horrified by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which persecuted them, necessitating an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] relief mission shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], led by [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]]. Clak'dor VII was one of the first planets [[Liberation of Clak'dor VII|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] (in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], immediately after the New Republic campaign to [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]]).

After the planet's liberation, Clak'dor VII remained isolated for some time. It was not until a Bith ambassador witnessed the [[Hapan]]s offer aid to the New Republic (and present [[Isolder]] as a gift to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]) that the planet joined the government.

Clak'dor VII was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] first by [[Nara Deega]] and later by [[E'noro]]. It was spared invasion during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
